name: AKU Researchers present to Princess Zahra Aga Khan

content.title: AKU Researchers present to Princess Zahra Aga Khan
content.summary: AKU's next generation of researchers present their work

media.alt: AKU Researchers present to Princess Zahra Aga Khan

content.text: As part of AKU's 40th anniversary festivities, the University hosted a research showcase titled 'At The Tipping Point'. The event, which was a first of its kind in AKU's history, was attended by Princess Zahra Aga Khan. The event aimed to showcase the University's dynamic research beyond the boundaries of education, health and life sciences.

The research topics, which ranged from wastewater surveillance to the status of refugees, proved how close AKU is working to achieve the vision by its Chancellor, His Highness the Aga Khan - to be a comprehensive university.  Researchers and faculty were praised by Princess Zahra Aga Khan for their dedication and hard work in making noteworthy contributions towards improving the developing world.

One of the highlights of the event was Dr Farah Qamar's work on typhoid elimination. Dr Qamar led groundbreaking research to investigate the outbreak of XDR typhoid in Pakistan. Her findings led to the introduction of the typhoid vaccine in the country's routine immunization programme. Dr Qamar has more than 100 publications in peer reviewed journals and is also the recipient of multiple awards, the most recent being the Tamgha-e Imtiaz awarded to her in recognition of her contribution to science and policy.

The showcase was also an opportunity for AKU's researchers and faculty to interact with each other, fostering an atmosphere of collaboration and innovation, with researchers from different fields exchanging ideas and discussing potential collaborations.

The judges' panel included:  Zeba Rasmussen, Research Fellow at National Institutes of Health, USA; Salim Virani, Vice President Research, AKU, Stephen Lyon, Inaugural Dean of AKU's Faculty of Arts and Sciences; and Claudia Hudspeth, Global Head of Health Programs, Aga Khan Foundation.
AKU is committed to producing research that makes a positive impact in society as well as promote research, innovation and development in Pakistan and beyond.
